structured_output.tldr: MCP SDK, embeddings, vector store, SQLite engine, release tooling, and time libraries all updated; decisions lock in v2 specs and modernized dependencies.
structured_output.summary: The MCP SDK ecosystem has undergone major updates affecting the plan: rmcp v2.1.0 (July 2026) implements stable MCP 2026-07-28; fastembed v7.0.0 (Sept 2026) adds new models and moved cache dirs; sqlite-vec 0.1.9 gained ANN indexes; Turso Database is production-ready but not yet adopted for v1. Release tooling migrated to dist 0.31–0.33 with GitHub artifact attestations. Key decisions lock in rmcp v2, fastembed v7 with BGESmallENV15Q as default, sqlite-vec for v1 (Turso for v2), and jiff for timestamps.
questions_answered: What version of rmcp should we use and why?
What are the default and alternative embedding models?
When should we enable sqlite-vec rescore indexing?
What is the timeline for adopting Turso Database?

1.0 slipped to "spring/summer 2026" — check whether it landed

decisions: Use rmcp v2 with server and transport-io features for stdio.
Default embedding model is BGESmallENV15Q; offer EmbeddingGemma300MQ4 as local-base alternative.
Keep sqlite-vec with brute-force for <50K sections; enable rescore index above that threshold.
Use rusqlite (bundled, FTS5) for v1; defer Turso Database adoption until it reaches 1.0 as the v2 candidate.
action_items: Monitor rusqlite version pin in sqlite-vec to avoid forced version conflicts.
Re-evaluate Turso Database adoption when it reaches v1.0 production status.
